📊 Key Insights

Auto-generated Executive Intelligence Report

📈
July — Peak Revenue Month at ₹7.9L
July 2025 generated the highest monthly revenue of ₹7,89,710, outperforming the annual monthly average by 16%. This surge aligns with Guru Purnima and festive season footfall.
🗺️
Madhya Pradesh — Top State at 7.7% of Revenue
Madhya Pradesh leads all 15 states with ₹6,26,610 in revenue (7.69% share). Its proximity to Vrindavan and strong devotee base drives consistent pilgrimage purchases.
📱
UPI is the Most Popular Payment with 1,029 Txns
UPI leads payment modes with 1,029 transactions (20.6%), reflecting the digital payment revolution among pilgrims. Cash remains significant at 1,022 transactions.
🙏
Spiritual Category Earns Highest Avg Rating of 4.03★
The Spiritual category commands the best customer satisfaction (4.03★), followed closely by Prasadam (4.02★). Devotees rate sacred items significantly higher than commercial products.
🧲
Fridge Magnet — Best-Selling Item at 824 Units
The Fridge Magnet is the most popular item by quantity (824 units), driven by its affordable price point and appeal as a shareable souvenir. It serves as a key entry-level purchase.
💎
"Other" Gender Segment Has Highest AOV at ₹1,711
The "Other" gender segment records the highest Average Order Value at ₹1,710.52, purchasing 8.5% more per transaction than Male (₹1,614) and 9.6% more than Female (₹1,561) segments.
